description: Enumerate federal subawards (subcontracts), optionally filtered by SUBAWARDEE name. Use for 'where does Leidos appear as a SUBcontractor, and under which primes' — surfaces the prime/sub network for teaming-map artifacts. NOTE: subRecipientName matches the SUB-recipient, NOT the prime (the keyless spending_by_award subaward view has no prime-name filter); to see the subs UNDER a specific prime, resolve that prime's awards first (usas_search_awards → usas_get_award_detail) and read their sub network. Each row carries subRecipient (the subawardee), amount, actionDate, the prime award id, and the prime award's NAICS.
name: usas_search_subawards
